dump_made_by: the wpr_trace source, in its one tracerpt call (raw/wpr_trace/session.json, runs); this source starts no process and reads the dump only when that source is observed
dump_format: XML, the documented event schema (one Event element per event; ExtendedTracingInfo/EventGuid for the event class, System/Opcode, System/TimeCreated/@SystemTime, EventData/Data/@Name)
bins: one second, counted from the trace header's StartTime on the trace's own clock (the header must name the performance counter); an event is placed by its rendered SystemTime
response_time_unit: microseconds: HighResResponseTime (KeQueryPerformanceCounter ticks) times 1000000 over the header's PerfFreq
percentiles: nearest rank over the response times of the row's disk requests
irp_flags: kept per row as the verbatim IrpFlags value (hex) with its operations and bytes; the paging share is derived from them by scripts/decode_diskio.py

pseudonyms.profile_name: the folder name under \Users becomes <profile>, whatever it is
pseudonyms.root_files: a file directly in the volume root is counted under the directory \ (pagefile.sys, swapfile.sys and hiberfil.sys are such files); its name is never kept
pseudonyms.other_components: every directory component that is not a fixed root or the one readable level below it becomes dir-<12 hex>, the first 12 hex digits of SHA-256 over a random salt and the lower cased path up to and including that component; the salt is made for this run and never written
pseudonyms.file_names: never kept; a row is per directory
pseudonyms.ntfs_metadata: the reserved NTFS names in the volume root ($Mft, $MftMirr, $LogFile, $Volume, $AttrDef, $Bitmap, $Boot, $BadClus, $Secure, $UpCase) are files counted under \ ; \$Extend is a fixed root, and the level below it stays readable only when it is one of the reserved names listed in ntfs_extend_children; any other name that starts with $ (the recycle bin, whose folders are named by account id, for one) is no root and becomes a pseudonym like every other directory
pseudonyms.extension: the lower cased text after the last dot of the name, with its dot, when it is one of kept_extensions; other when the name has a different one (the name may be a folder, whose tail must not be kept); null without one
pseudonyms.volume: the device name after \Device\ when the path starts with one and the name is 1 to 32 letters and digits (HarddiskVolume3), else a dir- pseudonym; null when the path carries no device
pseudonyms.collector_files: files under this bundle's own directory (the trace being written, the temporary recording, the dump) are counted with path_class collector and no directory
pseudonyms.unnamed_files: a disk or hard fault event whose file object has no name event anywhere in the trace is counted with path_class unnamed and no directory
pseudonyms.process_image: ImageFileName of the process kept when it is 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) + - starting with a letter or digit, else image-<12 hex> keyed like the directories; a thread with no Thread event in the trace has a null process
pseudonyms.command_lines_and_user_ids: never read: the Process events carry them and they stay in the trace and the dump on the PC
